description: Systems: what is opened and saved. A System is a root Component, with the packages beside it that the root and its children may import (catalog content, for instance). The top Language: it ties the layers together. Extends Mediation.

axioms.about: A System's root and packages are not nested
axioms.formula: all s in System, c in s.packages. no c.parent and no s.root.parent

axioms.about: A System's root is not one of its packages
axioms.formula: all s in System. not s.root in s.packages

axioms.about: Every Component is nested, or is the root or a package of a System
axioms.formula: all c in Component. some c.parent or some c.system or (some s in System. c in s.packages)
all s in System, k in s.root.importedComponents. k in s.packages

axioms.about: A package imports only other packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, c in s.packages, k in c.importedComponents. k != c and k in s.packages

axioms.about: The root imports Interactions only from packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, i in s.root.importedInteractions. i.component in s.packages

axioms.about: A package imports Interactions only from other packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, c in s.packages, i in c.importedInteractions. i.component != c and i.component in s.packages

axioms.about: The root imports Transformations only from packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, t in s.root.importedTransformations. t.component in s.packages

axioms.about: A package imports Transformations only from other packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, c in s.packages, t in c.importedTransformations. t.component != c and t.component in s.packages

axioms.about: The root imports Mediums only from packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, m in s.root.importedMediums. m.component in s.packages

axioms.about: A package imports Mediums only from other packages
axioms.formula: all s in System, c in s.packages, m in c.importedMediums. m.component != c and m.component in s.packages
